evidence.excerpt: We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays.
